note: Rewritten from the English description by Sands (1959); the original is in English, the soldier section supplements the description by Ghidini (1941), and the alate is recorded in the original as Imago. Unknown, so that caste is not included in this entry; the scan reads decimal points as colons (e.g. "0:68—0- 72"), the measurements are restored from the column positions and the means, only the ranges are adopted, and the pronotum length and width, which the original gives as single values only, are recorded as single values.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier resembles A. spinifer in size and body colour, but the shape of the mandibles differs: the mandibles are slender and evenly, slightly curved from near the base to the apex, and the tooth lies distinctly behind the middle, projecting, erect and equilateral-triangular. The head in lateral view resembles that of A. acinacifer, to which the species may be closely related. The alate is recorded in the original as not seen (Unknown). The postclypeus of the worker is slightly more inflated than in A. spinifer, and the third marginal tooth of the left mandible usually projects slightly beyond the cutting edge between it and the first marginal tooth.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule in lateral view continuously curved from the fontanelle to the occiput, the vertex evenly arched. Mandibles slender, evenly and slightly curved from near the base to the apex; the tooth distinctly behind the middle, projecting, erect and equilateral-triangular; the inner margin from the base of the tooth to the apex a regular arc, or slightly shallower near the base of the tooth. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 3 and 4 subequal, shorter than segment 5; segment 2 equal to segments 3 and 4 together. Head capsule with scattered setae. Anterior margin of the pronotum entire or slightly concave, the anterior lobe large. Anterior surface of the fore coxa with 3—5 spines in a group; the other legs with hairs and tibial spurs. Measurements (mm): head length 1.04—1.07; maximum head width 0.84—0.88; head width at the mandible base 0.68—0.72; head thickness 0.68—0.72; left mandible length 0.72—0.78; pronotum length 0.36; pronotum width 0.54; hind tibia length 0.70—0.75.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Body yellowish white. The postclypeus is slightly more inflated than in A. spinifer; the third marginal tooth of the left mandible usually projects slightly beyond the cutting edge between it and the first marginal tooth.
